decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures photo integration into the final proposal draft; the layout pass count and full-document coverage add no further candidate-specific change.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures use of GreenLatinos' existing colors and fonts; the source layout updates do not further change that branding state.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing final-draft table integration and treatment, so no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records delivery as a print-ready PDF; the source layout-pass changes do not alter the export requirement.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records one revision round, and the source layout updates add no further revision change.

The request for layout of a final draft may narrow the earlier obligation to package all narrative content, but the source does not unambiguously state whether narrative consolidation is removed or remains part of producing the full document.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not modify the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The source changes design scope but does not change the RFQ submission deadline or preferred submission date.
The source changes the layout approach and input stage but does not revise the anticipated page count.
